messages:
Nina: Heads-up  new guidance for international purchases, VAT reclaim, and per-diem rates. Summary below + links. Please review before submitting vendor forms. :globe_with_meridians:

Nina: TL;DR: 1) EU VAT reclaim flow is live (use "VAT reclaim" checkbox on vendor form). 2) Preferred invoicing currency: USD; if vendor invoices in EUR/GBP, include exchange rate and local tax docs. 3) Per-diem rates updated for travel >72hrs (country table on portal).

Nina: Portal: <https://redwood.internal/finance/international-payments|international payments & VAT docs>. Attach VAT invoices (with vendor tax ID) to avoid delays.

Sasha: For contractors in EU who invoice monthly in EUR, do we still need W-8/W-9?

Nina: Good Q. Contractors based in the US need W-9. Non-US contractors need the local tax form + a completed W-8BEN-E if applicable. Procurement will auto-request missing docs when you submit the vendor form.

VATBot: Automated note  VAT reclaim request created for "GeoMaps Ltd" by Sasha at 1803456925. Reference: VAT-2026-441. Please allow 10-12 business days.

Sasha: Thanks @VATBot. Also: how do we record exchange rates for expense reports? Manual or does Concur pull it?

Nina: Concur pulls a daily rate but we recommend adding the vendor-provided rate as a comment if it differs. For invoices, include the FX calculation in the invoice attachment (e.g., "€1,200 = $1,290 @ 1.075").

Diego: Per-diem question: Are meal receipts required if we use per-diem?

Nina: No need for meal receipts when claiming per-diem. Just pick the correct country code in Concur and attach travel approval. Receipts still required for non-per-diem expenses (taxis, hotels if billed to the company).

PeopleOps: Can we get a one-liner for onboarding to explain VAT docs for hires who travel internationally?

Nina: Yes  I'll draft a 3-line blurb for PeopleOps by EOD. It'll mention VAT docs, per-diem basics, and who to contact for questions.

Sasha: If a vendor refuses USD invoicing and insists on local VAT-inclusive pricing, is that a blocker?

Nina: Not a blocker. Mark the vendor currency on the form and check "VAT-inclusive" if applicable. Procurement will route to FinanceOps for VAT reclaim eligibility and update the vendor record.

VATBot: Reminder  invoices missing vendor tax ID will be auto-pended after 48 hours. (automated at 1803457020)

Diego: One last one  marketplace vendors (e.g., design tools)  will there be an "approved" list for multi-region billing?

Nina: Yes  we're publishing an approved marketplace list (team licenses, design, analytics) this week with region/currency notes. Use those vendors for faster onboarding. Link in the portal page.

Sasha: Great, that should speed things up. Thanks Nina. :thumbsup:

Nina: Thanks all. Ping @finance or DM me for weird edge cases.
